ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M2-3,
Light Industry District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.6-J in the area
bound by:

       The Atchison, Topeka, and Santa Fe Railway; a line 265.75 feet west of and parallel to
       South Kedzie Avenue; a line 204.42 feet north of and parallel to West 31st Street; South
       Kedzie Avenue; West 31st Street; and South Spaulding Avenue,

to those of a B3-1, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           ____________________________
                                                           Michael Rodriguez
                                                           Alderman, 22nd Ward




Common Address:
3214-3252 W. 31st Street
